title: 10 Best Bidens Chilensis Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Bidens chilensis are teas, decoctions, tinctures, oils, and creams, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to alleviate digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, involving longer boiling times, are preferred for extracting more potent compounds. Tinctures provide a concentrated form suitable for internal or topical use. Oils and creams infused with Bidens chilensis are applied externally to treat skin conditions and promote healing.
